title: Project Manifest - Consumer Sections Schema
description: Validates the consumer-owned sections of project-manifest.yaml (context, stack, concerns). The manifest: block is the substrate's contract and is validated separately against governance-commons/schemas/manifest.schema.json; this schema only constrains the consumer-added sections and otherwise allows the substrate-owned content through (additionalProperties true).

manifest.description: Substrate-owned block. Detailed shape validated by the substrate Consumer Manifest Schema, not here.

context.description: The profile dial's context facts. The operator declares what the project is; tooling/dial/resolve.py derives the rigor band from these via high-water-mark per axis. Optional: a missing block or fact defaults to its lowest level (the lean cell) and is reported under defaulted_facts. Each fact is a small fixed enum anchored on a named scheme (see the Stage 0 decision log).

data-sensitivity.description: Risk axis. FIPS 199 confidentiality; FedRAMP Low/Moderate/High.

network-exposure.description: Risk axis. Threat-model trust boundary and attack surface.

criticality.description: Risk axis. Blast-radius and reversibility; FIPS 199 integrity and availability.

agentic-surface.description: Overlay (not an axis input). Keys the agentic catalog and threat packs; refines stack.uses-llm for rigor purposes. EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM and Agentic.

stack.description: Governance-relevant facts about the project's technology, not version pins. Pins live in the tool files named by pins-source.

languages.description: Programming languages in use, e.g. [typescript, python].

datastore.description: Primary datastore: none | sqlite | postgres | mysql | other.

surfaces.description: Exposed surfaces: cli | http-api | web-frontend | library | none.

uses-llm.description: Whether the project calls models or runs agents at runtime. The dial's context.agentic-surface is the authoritative rigor fact and refines this.

pins-source.description: Tool files holding exact version pins, e.g. [".mise.toml", "package.json"].

concerns.description: Project-level concern posture established once by the concern-selector. Per-feature narrowing lives in specs/NNN-feature/feature-concerns.yaml.

always.description: Concern catalogs always in scope for this project.

never.description: Concern catalogs never applicable to this project.

build.description: How to produce and smoke-test the shipped artifact, consumed by the real-artifact verification tool (tooling/artifact/check.py). All fields optional; an absent build section means the tool has nothing to verify. Top-level section (the top level allows additional properties); it does not touch the stack block.

command.description: Shell command that builds the shipped artifact from source, e.g. 'pnpm build' or 'make build'.

artifact.description: Path the build produces and that is run/shipped, e.g. 'dist/' or 'dist/cli.js'. Informational; the tool rebuilds from source rather than trusting a stored copy.

smoke.description: A trivial invocation of the built artifact that must exit 0, e.g. 'node dist/cli.js --help'. Confirms the freshly built artifact actually runs.

test.description: Optional: the test command, recorded for traceability. Whether tests target source or the built artifact is a testing-strategy choice, not enforced by this tool.
